One of the best things about Bluesky is that it *is* a social network. I hadn't quite thought about it in these terms.

When people say it's boring, they are saying they want a personalised entertainment platform rather than a social network. Fine but that's not what this is or should be.

It does annoy me a bit how every news outlet now prefaces Bluesky as "the left wing social network" or whatever. It's very much a pit bull effect, bluesky gets a mention only if you're on the left, the fact that JD Vance has an account too doesn't count
it used to be that people didn't want to use open-source software because it was vastly inferior to proprietary software, but... have you seen proprietary software lately
You can also always ignore unfocused doom-tolling: it's the end of open source! the end of the Internet! the end of software! nahhhhhhhh, probably not- @baconandcoconut at #nbpy
